To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we find that different ranking models tend to produce output score distributions in different magnitudes, 2) we propose a new cross architecture knowledge distillation procedure that adapts the knowledge distillation process to the different score distributions and 3) our cross architecture distillation improves the effectiveness of four different architectures, including BERT, without compromising their efficiency.
